categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the design, research and development, production, and sales of high-molecular modified protective materials. The main products are functional protective sleeves (accounting for 78.04% of revenue), which are widely applied in automotive, engineering machinery, rail transit, and telecommunications electronics industries. The company also produces and sells other related products including single filaments, complex filaments, and supporting materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses core technologies in material formulation design, product structure design, and molding processes. It employs vertical integration production with self-developed modified formulations for PET, PA, PP, and PE materials. Production methods include spinning, weaving, textile, extrusion, and composite processes. The company has established manufacturing centers across multiple regions and implements a 'production based on sales plus reasonable inventory' model with MES system implementation for manufacturing execution.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are component suppliers in the automotive industry supply chain, including international and domestic leading wire harness and fluid pipeline manufacturers. End-market applications include major automotive manufacturers (BYD, NIO, XPeng, Li Auto, GAC Aion, etc.), engineering machinery companies (Caterpillar, Bobcat, SANY), rail transit manufacturers (CRRC), and telecommunications electronics companies (Molex, TE, Corning). The automotive industry accounts for 65.60% of revenue, with new energy vehicles representing 26,038.97 million yuan (72.61% growth).
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates manufacturing centers in Shenzhen, Dongguan, Suzhou (Kunshan), Wuhan, Chongqing, Jiangmen (all in China), and Mexico. The company has established subsidiaries including Dongguan Jundingda, Kunshan Jundingda, Jiangmen Jundingda, Suzhou Jundingda, Hong Kong Jundingda International, and JECAR TECH MEXICO. Domestic revenue accounts for 80.09% of total revenue, with international markets representing 19.91%.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates as a midstream supplier in the supply chain, positioned as a secondary supplier to primary component suppliers (wire harness and fluid pipeline manufacturers) who supply to original equipment manufacturers. The company controls the upstream production of functional single filaments and modified materials, implementing vertical integration from raw material modification through final product manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on developing high-performance modified materials for emerging applications including aerospace, wind power, photovoltaic, energy storage, medical devices, and low-altitude economy (flying cars, drones). R&D priorities include high-strength fluorine-containing sleeves, large-current soft connectors, high-flame-retardant PUR hoses, and materials for new energy vehicle applications. The company invested 41.6 million yuan in R&D (4.81% of revenue) with 110 R&D personnel, emphasizing material formulation optimization and new product development.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of functional protective sleeves and related products to component suppliers. Revenue is recognized when products are delivered to customers and control is transferred. The company employs a direct sales model with pricing determined through commercial negotiations based on technical requirements, purchase volume, and market competition. Domestic sales account for 80.09% of revenue, with export sales at 19.91%.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic enterprise in the functional protective sleeve market. Competitors are categorized into three tiers: (1) technology-leading multinational companies with superior raw materials and scale; (2) domestic leading enterprises with product diversification and improving competitiveness; (3) small-scale producers with limited capabilities. The company ranks among the top domestic competitors with strong technical capabilities, comprehensive product lines, and established customer relationships, though smaller than international giants in scale.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company achieved 2024 revenue of 864.5 million yuan (34.30% growth from 643.7 million in 2023) and net profit of 176.0 million yuan (26.01% growth from 139.7 million in 2023). Total assets reached 1.503 billion yuan (82.33% increase from 824.6 million), with shareholders' equity of 1.269 billion yuan (95.90% increase). The company completed IPO in March 2024, raising 484.1 million yuan net proceeds. Operating cash flow was 90.1 million yuan in 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through superior material formulation technology, comprehensive product customization capabilities, and integrated service solutions. Products offer excellent performance in heat resistance, UV resistance, flame retardancy, and chemical corrosion resistance. The company provides one-stop service covering design, development, testing, batch production, and after-sales support. Vertical integration ensures quality control and cost advantages. The company has obtained multiple industry certifications (ISO9001, IATF16949, GMW14327) and serves as one of the few domestic enterprises simultaneously integrated into domestic, joint-venture, and foreign brand OEM supply chains.
